_comment_led-setup: configure to match your led setup
_comment_gap_per_port: if you have 'unused' LEDs between every port
_comment_gap_start: 'start' is the number of 'unused' LEDs before the first port
_comment_gap_end: 'end' is the number of 'unused' LEDs after the last port
_comment_gap_rows: 'unused' number of LEDs after last port firs row and first port second row
_comment_gap_block: 'block_size' indicates after how many ports a gap is added, and 'gap after block' is the size of this gap
_comment_manual_mapping: If you want to continue using a manual string list, that is also possible:
_comment_scan_base: This is the first three blocks of the ip address your switch should be in
_comment_switch_ip: Only the IP address without https:// - is not used if ip_scan=true
_comment_fixed_ip: This is the IP your Raspi is assigned, must end with /24 for subnet configuration
_comment_fixed_gw: gateway and dns_server won't effect much of this script
_comment_port_stats: if false only vlan-color will be shown
_comment_scanned_vlans: if scan_vlans=true the vlan names of your switch config will be added here, matched with the vlan_color_map, which is ID:r,g,b;
